description: This file defines the Unicode utility class providing functions for Unicode character handling, string truncation, case conversion, and UTF-8 validation within the Drupal project.

classes.name: Unicode
classes.description: Utility class providing Unicode-related string operations, encoding detection, and validation functions.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current environment's Unicode support status: single-byte, multibyte, or error.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks for PHP Unicode support via mbstring extension and configuration.

methods.name: encodingFromBOM
methods.description: Detects the encoding from a byte-order mark (BOM) in data.

methods.name: convertToUtf8
methods.description: Converts data from a specified encoding to UTF-8 using iconv or mbstring.

methods.name: truncateBytes
methods.description: Safely truncates a UTF-8 string to a specified byte length, ensuring no partial characters.

methods.name: ucfirst
methods.description: Capitalizes the first character of a UTF-8 string.

methods.name: lcfirst
methods.description: Converts the first character of a UTF-8 string to lowercase.

methods.name: ucwords
methods.description: Capitalizes the first character of each word in a UTF-8 string.

methods.name: truncate
methods.description: Truncates a UTF-8 string to a specified length, optionally on word boundaries and with ellipsis.

methods.name: strcasecmp
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive, binary-safe comparison of two UTF-8 strings.

methods.name: validateUtf8
methods.description: Checks whether a string is valid UTF-8.
